Florida Woman Wears 'Retired Drug Dealer' Shirt. Deputies Say the Retirement Didn't Take.

A traffic stop in Citrus County turned up a backpack, a scale, 150 tiny baggies and a ledger. The shirt was not helping.

Citrus County deputies say a 54-year-old woman riding in the back of a pulled-over vehicle was wearing a T-shirt that read "Retired Drug Dealer." They say her backpack held crack cocaine, a digital scale, about 150 empty baggies and a ledger of names and dollar amounts. She was arrested Nov. 20 on drug, contraband and warrant charges.
